value.name: inspector examines the house
value.description: The inspector measures rooms, photographs moldings, taps plaster, and inspects the basement and roof while filling his clipboard.
evidence: He measured the rooms and photographed the moldings and tapped the plaster and went down into the basement with Lucia and up onto the roof with no one and came down again with his hair slightly disordered and his clipboard full.

value.name: inspector promises report by Wednesday
value.description: At the door, the inspector tells Lucia he will deliver the report by Wednesday morning.
evidence: He told Lucia, at the door, that he would have the report by Wednesday morning

value.name: inspector warns valuation will differ
value.description: The inspector explains that the report's number will not match the buyers' offer or what a sane seller would refuse.
evidence: and that the number would not be the number the buyers had offered, and that it would not be the number any sane seller would refuse if a sane buyer made it

value.name: inspector declines to advise on difference
value.description: He says the gap between the two numbers is not his question to answer.
evidence: but that those two numbers were not, in his experience, the same number, and that the question of what to do with the difference was not his question to answer.

value.name: Lucia thanks the inspector
value.description: Lucia thanks the inspector after he finishes speaking.

value.name: Lucia calls Asha
value.description: After the inspector leaves, Lucia calls Asha from the kitchen.
evidence: She called Asha from the kitchen after he left.

value.name: Lucia reports report timing
value.description: Lucia tells Asha that the inspector said the report will be ready by Wednesday morning.
evidence: "He says it will be by Wednesday morning."

value.name: Lucia declares house will not be sold
value.description: Lucia tells Asha that she and her brother have decided not to sell the house.
evidence: "My brother and I are not going to sell the house."

value.name: Asha asks Lucia to explain
value.description: Asha stops writing and asks Lucia to tell her more about the decision.

value.name: Lucia outlines new plan
value.description: Lucia explains that they have decided not to sell, will need structures and Asha's help, and want to meet Monday week to discuss those structures instead of the sale.
evidence: "We do not know yet what we are going to do. We have agreed that we are not going to sell. We have agreed that the things we are going to do instead will require structures, and that the structures will require you, and that we will come on Monday week prepared to discuss the structures rather than the question of whether to sell."

value.name: Lucia insists Rosa must be included
value.description: Lucia says Rosa must be part of the structures conversation and that her presence in the house is non-negotiable.
evidence: "We have agreed that Rosa is part of the conversation about the structures, not as an employee and not as a witness but as a person whose presence in the house is, in our shared view, not negotiable."

value.name: Lucia rejects professional pretense
value.description: Lucia begins to state that they will not pretend in Asha's presence or any professional setting, signaling a further challenge to the existing arrangement.
